extracted.name: Teriyaki and Pineapple Chicken
extracted.description: This teriyaki and pineapple chicken recipe blends crisp-sweet bell peppers, pineapple, mushrooms, and chicken for a hearty dish that tastes delicious.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook until no longer pink in centers and juices run clear, 7 to 10 minutes.

Add mushrooms, onion, bell peppers, teriyaki sauce, pineapple chunks and juice, garlic powder, and pepper flakes. Reduce heat to medium; bring to a simmer. Stir in flour; simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes.
